title: Renaming a class member in a @tool script and saving causes memory corruption (?)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 18 Dec 2025 18:00:18 +0000 on Tty - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (RADV NAVI23) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4790 CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads) - 15.49 GiB memory

### Issue description

```gdscript
@tool
extends Node

var num := 1

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	print(num)
```
When I change all occurrences of "num" to something else and save the script, `<null>` is printed instead of `1`. The behavior becomes correct once I use _**Scene > Reload Saved Scene**_.

Note also that when the member is a `PackedByteArray` (or any object probably but I've not tested this) and a method is called on it (I tested `clear` and `size`) then it causes the editor to crash after doing the rename and save.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP,
2. Open node.tscn and node.gd,
3. Ensure the tool script is executing,
4. Rename `num` to something else,
5. Observe as `<null>` is printed instead of `1`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24397867/mrp.zip)
